verdict.rationale: Docs confirm physics engine integration (Havok, Cannon.js, Ammo.js) and community notes mention collision support and physics plug-ins, but a detailed hands-on community critique specifically contradicts the 'works out of the box' claim, alleging Babylon's physics conflates velocity/acceleration dimensions and ignores real-world time/frame-rate scaling, with a separate reviewer echoing that it 'doesn't care for real-world physics scale.' Missing for 10: raycast documentation/evidence, rigid-body setup examples, and any rebuttal or fix confirmation for the cited physics correctness bugs.
